_comment: Editorial content for ABL. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: the bank's own imagery is not licence-cleared and a generic bank-branch photograph would imply it is theirs. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available.
description: Allied Bank Limited is a Pakistani commercial bank that started in Lahore as Australasia Bank in 1942 and took its present name in 2005, after its ownership was transferred to a consortium comprising the Ibrahim Group in August 2004. It offers universal banking services while placing major emphasis on retail banking, with a network of over 1,500 online branches and more than 1,500 ATMs in Pakistan. Its parent company is Ibrahim Holdings (Private) Limited and its subsidiaries are ABL Asset Management Company and ABL Exchange (Private) Limited.
headOffice: 3 Tipu Block, Main Boulevard, New Garden Town, Lahore 54000, Pakistan
